# Read in the data

```{r}
#| label: load merged antibody and fake treatment data
#| message: false 
#-------------------------------
# load the dataset
# for WASH Benefits Bangladesh
# baseline table should include individuals
# included in the final visit
#-------------------------------
d1 <- read_rds(file = here("../../data/bangl/luminex/final/",
                           "washb_bangl_luminex_igg_seropos_pathogen_2026-09-16.rds")) %>%
  # final visit only
  filter(visit == 3) %>%
  distinct(clusterid, tr, childid, eed, dob) %>%
#  left_join(tx, by = join_by(clusterid)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(tr)) %>%
  # Indicatior for WSH and Nutrition interventions
  mutate(wsh = ifelse(tr %in% c("WSH","Nutrition + WSH"), 1, 0), 
         nutr = ifelse(tr %in% c("Nutrition","Nutrition + WSH"), 1, 0),
         wshf = ifelse(wsh==1,"WASH","No WASH"),
         nutrf = ifelse(nutr==1,"Nutrition","No Nutrition"),
         wshf = factor(wshf, levels=c("No WASH","WASH")),
         nutrf = factor(nutrf, levels=c("No Nutrition","Nutrition")))

master_child <- read_csv("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/washb-serology/data/bangl/anthro/washb-bangladesh-anthro.csv") %>%
#master_child <- read_csv("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/washb-serology/data/bangl/diarrhea/washb-bangladesh-diar.csv") %>%
  mutate(childid2 = paste0("child-",dataid,"-",substr(childid,2,2))) %>%
  select(dataid,clusterid,childid=childid2,sex) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(childid = as.character(childid)) 

master_hh <- read_csv("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/washb-serology/data/bangl/baseline/washb-bangladesh-enrol.csv") %>%
  select(dataid,clusterid,hhid,
         # Maternal
         momage, momedu, momeduy, momheight, #nulliparous,
         # Paternal
         dadeduy, dadagri,
         # Household
         Nhh, Ncomp, Nlt18, elec, floor, asset_mobile, asset_phone, asset_moto, roof, walls,
         asset_radio, asset_tvbw, asset_tvcol, asset_tv, asset_refrig, asset_bike, asset_sewmach, 
         asset_wardrobe, asset_table, asset_chair, asset_clock, asset_khat, asset_chouki, 
         # Drinking water
         tubewell, watmin, storewat, treatwat,
         # Sanitation
         latown, latslab, latseal, latfeces, potty, humfeces, humfecesch,
         # Handwashing location
         hwlat, hwlatwat, hwlatsoap, hwkit, hwkitwat, hwkitsoap, hwsw, hwss, hwsws,
         # Food security
         hfiacat
         ) 

iwi_df <- read_rds(file = here("../../data/iwi/",
                           "df_iwi_study.rds")) %>%
  filter(study == "WASHB") %>%
  rename(dataid = study_pid)

d_tab1 <- d1 %>%
  left_join(master_child, by = join_by(childid)) %>%
  select(-c(clusterid.y)) %>%
  select(clusterid=clusterid.x,tr,childid,dob,wsh,nutr,wshf,nutrf,dataid,sex) %>%
  left_join(master_hh, by = c(join_by(dataid,clusterid))) %>%
  left_join(iwi_df, by =join_by(dataid)) %>%
  mutate(
    across(where(is.labelled), ~ as_factor(.x, levels = "default"))
  )


```

```{r}
#| label: variable cleaning

# Create categorical paternal education to be consistent with maternal education and binary hfias variable
d_tab1 <- d_tab1 %>%
  mutate(
    dadedu = case_when(
      dadeduy == 0 ~ "No education",
      dadeduy >= 1 & dadeduy <= 5 ~ "Primary (1-5y)",
      dadeduy > 5 ~ "Secondary (>5y)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    dadedu = factor(dadedu,
                         levels = c("No education", "Primary (1-5y)", "Secondary (>5y)"))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    hfiacat_bin = case_when(
      hfiacat %in% c("Food Secure", 
                     "Mildly Food Insecure") ~ "No/mild insecure",
      hfiacat %in% c("Moderately Food Insecure", 
                     "Severely Food Insecure") ~ "Mod/severe insecure",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    hfiacat_bin = factor(hfiacat_bin, 
                         levels = c("No/mild insecure", "Mod/severe insecure"))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    latrine_own_seal = case_when(
      latown == 0 ~ "No latrine",
      latown == 1 & latseal == 0 ~ "Latrine without water seal",
      latown == 1 & latseal == 1 ~ "Latrine with water seal",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    latrine_own_seal = factor(latrine_own_seal,
                                levels = c("No latrine", "Latrine without water seal",
                                           "Latrine with water seal"))
  ) %>%
  # treat "Missing/DK" as NA
  mutate(
    asset_phone = na_if(asset_phone, 9)
  ) 


# Make selected variables factors in d_tab1
vars_to_factor <- c(
  "momedu",
  "dadedu", "dadagri",
  "elec", "floor",
  "asset_mobile", "asset_phone", "asset_moto",
  "roof", "walls",
  "asset_radio", "asset_tvbw", "asset_tvcol", "asset_tv",
  "asset_refrig", "asset_bike", "asset_sewmach", "asset_wardrobe",
  "asset_table", "asset_chair", "asset_clock",
  "asset_khat", "asset_chouki",
  "tubewell", "storewat", "treatwat",
  #"latown", "latslab", "latseal", "latfeces", "potty",
  "latrine_own_seal",
  #"humfeces", "humfecesch",
  #"hwlat", "hwlatwat", "hwlatsoap",
  #"hwkit", "hwkitwat", "hwkitsoap",
  #"hwsw", "hwss", 
  "hwsws",
  "hfiacat_bin"
)

# optionally check any missing columns (won't error)
missing_vars <- setdiff(vars_to_factor, names(d_tab1))
if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  warning("These variables are not in d_tab1: ", paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", "))
}

# convert those that exist
vars_present <- intersect(vars_to_factor, names(d_tab1))
d_tab1[vars_present] <- lapply(d_tab1[vars_present], factor)

# confirm
str(d_tab1[vars_present])

```

# Marginal arms
```{r}

marg_wsh_wide <- d_tab1 %>%
  mutate(
    wshf_col = recode(as.character(wsh),
                  `0` = "No WASH",
                  `1` = "Combined WASH",
                  ),
    wshf_col = factor(wshf_col, levels = c("Combined WASH", "No WASH"))
  )


marg_nutr_wide <- d_tab1 %>%
  mutate(
    nutr_col = recode(as.character(nutr),
                  `0` = "No Nutrition",
                  `1` = "Combined Nutrition",
                  ),
    nutr_col = factor(nutr_col, levels = c("Combined Nutrition", "No Nutrition"))
  )
```
